repo: mustafa-alhaiba-2003/Kashkash (private; found through the owner's GitHub access list, not in work/repos.jsonl or work/trees, and no local folder)
notes: Real screenshot of the storefront's own product list page (templates/base.html + templates/product/product_list.html, ProductListView at /), templates untouched. Ran a copy on Python 3.15 with Django 6.1.3 (the repo does not pin versions), SQLite via the project's own development settings, on 127.0.0.1:8133; captured at a 1280x800 viewport (x1.75 -> 2240x1400) because the grid only becomes its intended 4 columns at >=1280px. Tailwind and the Cairo font load from their CDNs as base.html asks. Sample data seeded through the ORM: 4 categories and 14 fruit/vegetable products with prices in the template's own currency label; the product pictures are sample images generated locally (a fruit emoji on a soft gradient, the same idea as the template's own no-image fallback), not real product photos. Changes confined to the run copy: a .env with dummy values; makemigrations for the 'settings' app (the repo ships no migration for it) and for Category.order (the model has the field but the committed migrations do not); a placeholder WhatsApp number so the nav link renders (the number itself is not visible). One capture-time CSS tweak: the repo does not contain static/logo.png (it is supplied on the server), so the white logo tile showed a broken image; the tile is collapsed to zero width, keeping the header at its real height (the untouched capture is alt-with-missing-logo.png). The page heading sits under the fixed header exactly as the project's own CSS lays it out (body padding 80px vs a taller navbar), so only the subtitle is visible. The product detail page was not used: its 'you save' line renders without the amount.
